title_as_listed: CHEFMAN 6 Quart Dual Basket Air Fryer Oven with Easy View Windows, Sync Finish, Hi-Fry, Auto Shutoff, 2 Independent 3Qt Nonstick Dishwasher Safe Frying Baskets, Digital Double Air Fryer - Black

editorial.dek: Two 3-quart baskets that can finish at the same time, in the space one basket usually takes.
editorial.best_for: Cooking a main and a side together
editorial.catch: Each basket is 3 quarts, so one large item — a whole bird, a full sheet pan — will not fit in either one.
check_before_buying: Measure your counter depth against the listed 13.38" and leave room in front for the drawer to pull out.
Decide whether you cook two things at once. If you usually cook one, a single 8-quart basket is the simpler buy.
Check on the listing which parts are dishwasher-safe before you plan on hand-washing them.

listing_conflicts.note: The listing's own details table gives Capacity: 6 liters, while the title and the bullet copy say 6-quart / two 3-quart baskets. The quart figure is the one the product name and the two-basket claim use, so that is what this site records. Units disagree on the source page.

faq: Is this a dual-basket air fryer?

Yes. The listing's title names two independent 3-quart baskets, and its bullet copy describes a combined 6-quart capacity with a Sync Finish so the baskets can finish together. That is the feature that separates it from the single-basket 8-quart in the same shop.

The listing's bullet copy states a digital temperature range of 200-450F, and the title names a Hi-Fry setting. Note that the same page's details table gives the capacity as '6 liters' while the title says 6 quart - the two units disagree on one page (FLG-018).
What should I measure before buying?
The listed footprint is 13.38"D x 11.81"W x 10.63"H and the listed weight is 13.3 lb. Measure the depth of your counter and the clearance above the unit, not just the square footage you have free.
